blind.description: A rectangular, neatly trimmed box hedge. The geometry forms an elongated rectangular prism with dense, bumpy foliage texture covering all sides and the top. The surface is continuous without detached leaves, floating flakes, or holes. It rests flat on the ground without any separate base or planter.
blind.from_above: A vertically oriented rectangular strip of dense green foliage with slightly bumpy edges and a subtle central seam running along its length.
blind.height_vs_figure: About half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 2.5 to 3 feet tall) and roughly as long as the figure is tall.
